description: User-installable hi-res recipe for Zelda - Ocarina of Time (USA) Rev 0. EMULATOR-VERIFIED ONLY: 640x240 PROGRESSIVE (no interlace) verified through the whole boot chain (logo -> title -> File Select) in mupen64plus; not yet validated on real N64 hardware. Copy this file into ~/.n64patcher/patches/ and the .bps into the bundled hires_patches directory (or adjust the path) to enable it. Requires an Expansion Pak.

patches.name: Zelda - Ocarina of Time (USA) Rev 0 - 640x240p (EXPERIMENTAL)
patches.source: N64-Universal-Smart-Patcher project - built from the zeldaret/oot decomp, see scripts/oot_hires/
patches.notes: 640x240 progressive: the boot VI tables (osViModeNtscLan1/MpalLan1) carry a 640-wide 1:1 mode (NTSC 1.0 never re-issues osViSetMode), gScreenWidth is widened (.data + Main boot + ViMode_Update NOP), the framebuffer pair grows to 2x 640x240 and the 8MB fb-end moves to the Expansion Pak area so the game heap keeps its stock size. View_Init widens the viewport so the 3D fills the width. Title and File Select land correctly; dialogs/HUD with compile-time 320 positions stay upper-left (per-renderer 2D pass pending). Known risk: gZBuffer stays 320x240, so the 640-wide scissor overflows into gGfxSPTaskOutputBuffer (survived in the emulator). Needs an Expansion Pak. Hardware validation pending.
patches.outputs_note: Declared safely here (unlike the code-segment-only routes): the 640p patch edits the boot VI tables inside the CIC-6102 checksum window, so the restamped output ROM has its own CRC pair and cannot self-key the clean dump.
